claims.text: Pneumococcal vax in CKD; influenza vax for pt and household contacts.
claims.quote: Use pneumococcal vaccine in patients with glomerular disease and nephrotic syndrome, as well as patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD). Patients and household contacts should receive the influenza vaccine

claims.text: Adult hemodialysis: HepB as Engerix 40 µg (two 1 mL doses) @ 0, 1, 2 and 6 months.
claims.quote: A 4-dose schedule of Engerix administered in two 1 mL doses (40 µg) on a 0-, 1-, 2-, and 6-month schedule is recommended for adult hemodialysis patients

claims.text: Heplisav-B: safety and effectiveness ⍉established in adults on hemodialysis.
claims.quote: Safety and effectiveness of HEPLISAV-B have not been established in adults on hemodialysis
